- [ ] **Used semantic containers?** (e.g., `HeaderedContainer` instead of `Border` with manual heade
- [ ] **Avoided redundant properties?** Use shared styles in `axaml` files.
- [ ] **Minimized nesting?** Flatten layouts using `EdgePanel` or generic components.
- [ ] **Icons via extension?** Use `{Icon fa-name}` and `IconOptions` for styling.

content.user_title: Build Clean Avalonia Layouts With Zafiro
content.value_statement: Avalonia layouts can become repetitive, deeply nested, and hard to maintain. This skill gives focused guidance for Zafiro.Avalonia containers, shared styles, icons, and behaviors.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use HeaderedContainer, EdgePanel, Card, StackPanel, Grid, and UniformGrid.
Guides extraction of repeated XAML into reusable controls and shared styles.
Shows how to define shared icons and apply IconOptions consistently.
Recommends behaviors, ViewModel properties, and MultiBinding before simple converters.
Provides a clean layout checklist for reviewing Avalonia views.
Points to theme files for colors, brushes, typography, containers, and resources.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not generate or validate a full Avalonia project by itself.
It assumes the project uses Zafiro.Avalonia or compatible controls.
It does not replace accessibility, localization, or visual design review.
One referenced local example path may not exist in another workspace.

use_cases.title: Refactor Repetitive Views
use_cases.description: Convert repeated XAML sections into semantic containers, shared classes, and small reusable components.

use_cases.title: Design a Theme Structure
use_cases.description: Organize colors, brushes, styles, icons, and merged dictionaries for a maintainable Avalonia theme.

use_cases.title: Review Layout Quality
use_cases.description: Check an existing view for redundant properties, deep nesting, overused converters, and inconsistent icon styling.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Container
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building an Avalonia view with sections, rows, and actions. Recommend the best Zafiro.Avalonia containers and explain each choice.

prompt_templates.title: Reduce Repetition
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Avalonia XAML for repeated properties and nested layout patterns. Suggest shared styles, classes, and reusable controls.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Theme Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me organize an Avalonia theme using separate files for colors, brushes, containers, typography, and icons. Include the merge order.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complex View
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this complex Avalonia view for maintainability. Focus on semantic containers, DynamicResource use, IconOptions, behaviors, and converter removal.

output_examples.input: A settings page repeats section headers, borders, colors, and icon styling across many panels.
output_examples.output: The response recommends HeaderedContainer variants, shared theme classes, and IconOptions. It also identifies repeated visual properties to move into style files.

output_examples.input: A details view uses nested grids for label, value, and action rows.
output_examples.output: The response suggests EdgePanel rows, reusable summary items, and flatter layout structure. It explains where Grid remains appropriate.

output_examples.input: A form uses converters for focus, formatting, and visibility decisions.
output_examples.output: The response separates visual conversions from application state. It recommends ViewModel properties, MultiBinding, or behaviors based on the interaction.

best_practices: Read only the referenced file that matches the current layout problem.
Move repeated visual properties into shared axaml style files.
Prefer semantic Zafiro.Avalonia controls before adding nested generic panels.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode colors, brush values, or repeated sizes in views.
Do not create deep Grid and StackPanel nesting for simple rows.
Do not use converters for logic that belongs in the ViewModel or a behavior.

faq.question: Does this skill write Avalonia code automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and review criteria. The AI tool can apply changes when you ask it to edit project files.

faq.question: Do I need Zafiro.Avalonia installed?
faq.answer: Yes, most recommendations assume Zafiro.Avalonia controls such as HeaderedContainer, EdgePanel, Card, IconExtension, and IconOptions.

faq.question: Can it help with existing XAML?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste or reference a view and ask for a review focused on nesting, styles, icons, and converters.

faq.question: Does it cover theme organization?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends separated color, brush, style, icon, and theme aggregation files.

faq.question: Is it specific to one sample project?
faq.answer: No. It references Angor as an example, but the guidance is general for Avalonia projects.

faq.question: Can it replace UI design review?
faq.answer: No. It improves layout maintainability, but teams should still review accessibility, interaction design, and visual consistency.
